newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tuan Sing to buy property in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Tuan Sing to buy property in Shanghai.

text.p: Singapore's Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd said on Friday its wholly-owned subsidiary Finsbury Pte Ltd had agreed a pre-sale contract to buy the 18th floor of Shui On Plaza in Shanghai from Shanghai Jiu Hai Rimmer Properties Co Ltd.
It said in a statement the sale price of the property in the 23-storey office and commercial complex was US$8.78 million, based on a gross floor area of 2,576 square metres.
The purchase will be financed from internal resources and/or bank borrowings.
Under the terms of the contract, Finsbury will take possession of the property by April 1, 1997, subject to full payment of the sale price.
The statement said the property would be used to accomodate Tuan Sing's rapidly expanding Shanghai operations, now housed in rented premises.
